Results.ReviewText: I have always loved a weber but I have noticed the quality has gone down.  No longer can you expect a sturdy well built grill.  Today, they must be made from cheaper material to save money
Results.Title: Quality Down

Results.ReviewText: this is a great no frills grill easy to move.  one suggestion- the lip that holds the grill lid onto the base ( the kettle part) should be a tad bigger so it is more secure more secure.
Results.Title: moveable grill

Results.ReviewText: Amazing charcoal grill.Quality is excellent.Would highly recommend this grill.Another great design Weber has created.
Results.Title: 22” Weber charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Same quality as the last one, with one complaint   They removed the 2nd handle, I assume to cut costs. I would gladly pay a little extra to be able to move the grill around a little easier and have extra space to hang utensils.
Results.Title: Where did the 2nd handle go??

Results.ReviewText: This is the best 22 inch charcoal kettle grill I have ever owned. I'm impressed with this Weber grill keeping constant cooking temperature of what ever you're cooking. I'm very satisfied and recommend this Weber to everyone I know.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText:
A Weber kettle was my first charcoal grill (talking early ‘80s), and it was a solid cooking partner for many years until I finally replaced it with a Brinkman. After some 25 years on that grill, I “upgraded” to a Char Griller offset smoker. Big mistake, as it wasn’t able to a) handle the heat from a wood fire and b) was frustrating to use as a direct charcoal grill due to the decreased distance between the fire and the food. By then, Brinkman was no mas, and I was stuck.

Ultimately it was decided that the smoking was going to happen on a Yoder pellet grill, and the food that really shines when cooked over charcoal was gonna happen on a new Weber.

Gotta hand it to Weber, they didn’t mess too much with what was already working. I appreciate the heat shield underneath the handle on the lid, and the temperature gauge is also a welcome addition. Get the Premium though, so you’ll have that handy ash clean out. It’s a safety issue really, since it helps prevent hot ashes/tiny bits of glowing coal from blowing around. Easy to disengage and empty, and you’ll only have to do that every 3 cooks or so.

The lid still sits nice and snug on the kettle’s bottom, so you can close things up when you’re done and the fire suffocates quickly (very handy for conserving charcoal). I also love the two hinged sections of the cooking grate, so you can add more fuel without having to lift the grate/food out of the way.

If I could change one thing, it would be the orientation of the under-lid hook to 0° from the handle as opposed to its current 90°. I’m used to it now, but it does pose a greater risk of skin-to-hot lid contact. The plastic grips attached to the handles do a good job of dissipating heat, but time will tell if they hold up like their hardwood predecessors. The wheels roll well and while also made of plastic, they’re not getting hit with the heat from the kettle.

When this grill isn’t in use I cover it with a Weber cover. A pretty janky cover, in direct contrast to the awesome kettle grill. It’s too short to adequately cover those plastic wheels and a little too roomy, with only a single Velcro loop to secure it. Any kind of wind causes it to loft right off. The material itself seems cheap, too. When it goes down I’ll shop around for something more substantial for sure.
Results.Title: The OG of Kettle Grills

Results.ReviewText: Using this new grill is like pulling a cast iron skillet out of the cabinet: I instantly know its best use and best features. I owned one over twenty years ago which ended up worn out and was discarded in a move. I like the ash collection a lot, and the bottom swivel vent clears ash out by swinging it open closed a few times.
Results.Title: Back to the Classic Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Great versatile grill that can crush easy items like burgers and has handled some smoking very well too. No problems with this grill so far.
Results.Title: Great versatile grill

Results.ReviewText: I ordered this grill from Home Depot,the first one was delivered with a bent top the second was delivered where the screws on handle didn’t align with the cover, thus I had to tape the handle. I love the grill but I am surprised that Weber allows their products to be sent out this way.
Results.Title: Surprised that Weber allows

Results.ReviewText: Amazing versatile grill. I've been able to grill and to smoke foods on it with very minimal set up. The more I learn about this grill, the more interesting it has become.
Results.Title: Most Versatile Grill Ever!

Results.ReviewText: Amazing charcoal grill!  Great for beginners like me.  Easy to get the hang of quickly and perfect steaks every time!
Results.Title: The gold standard for charcoal grills!

Photos.Caption: Pork shoulder indirect cook using the vortex

Results.ReviewText: Great barbeque for beginners or those who would like to elevate their bbq game. I use mine every weekend and days it gets too hot to cook in the house. For those who want to step things up, look into the vortex grilling accessory.  I've smoked briskets and pork shoulders on the weber, as well as cooking beer can chicken, chicken legs and thighs indirectly that have a nice crispy skin when done.
Results.Title: Great barbeque for beginners and the advanced.

Results.ReviewText: Weber has always been the pinnacle of charcoal grills in America. In fact I always had my eyes open looking for a second hand Weber. People just don’t let go of them .So when I finally decided to buy a grill for my vacation home it had to be a Weber.
Results.Title: Buy the best forget the rest.

Results.ReviewText: I had a gas smoker, Weber Gas Grill and the Weber Kettle.  I use all three depending on what I am trying cook.  The smoker is great if you have a lot of ribs or chicken, the gas grill for quick burgers, brats and steaks, but I really like the kettle for prime rib roasts and whole turkeys.  It is easy to setup and control the heat and the flavors that come out are great without getting to crazy with wood chips.  The ability to easily add coals to the sides enables longer cooking times.  The family loves the results.
Results.Title: Tops in flexibility, ease of use and control.

Results.ReviewText: We have been using Weber grills for over 40 years.  Love the kettle with the ash pan to collect ashes from the charcoal.  It makes for easy cleanup after several grilling events, not constantly cleaning the pan.  I have made planters out of our oldest grills, an idea I got from eating at a Weber themed restaurant in Chicago.  Our grills are used all year and many times a week.  We have owned 4, 3 large kettles and one small for picnics.  They last for years if you cover them with the Weber covers, others don’t last.  Weber for life.
Results.Title: Weber for life!

Results.ReviewText: This is my second kettle grill from Weber. The first one is over ten years old and still doing great. I bought this one because I needed more grill space. I find this one is just as well-built and sturdy as my first one.
Results.Title: Still the best charcoal grill I’ve ever owned.

Results.ReviewText: We have a gas grill (Weber spirit) for daily use, but wanted the option to do grilling over charcoal & add a little smoke flavor to some cookouts. We looked at specialty smokers, but in the end decided the Weber kettle gives us the most flexibility in fuels & style of grilling. Never crossed my mind to look for a different brand — Weber is the stand alone favorite in my mind for an affordable grill that I know will stand up to weather and use. I like the ash collection bucket on this model — much neater than the ones where the ash drops onto the tray below. Of course you have to assemble it, but can easily be done by one person (took me about 1/2 hr). I have no regrets about this purchase and consider it a long term addition to west coast outdoor living.
Results.Title: Well, what did you expect? It’s a Weber!

Results.ReviewText: I have not had this grill for a year yet and the handle gave out. Trying to make a warranty claim was the most difficult thing that I have ever done. Customer service reps were very hard to understand and did not help ….this led to what has now been a month and a half of correspondence with an un operable grill.   Weber sending me piece by piece the lid Assembly as the paint was damaged when the handle broke. Here I am a month and a half later still waiting on a backordered damper for the lid after I had to call customer service four times and numerous emails as well as sending at least 30 pictures of the damage before the warranty team was responsive . I have a few Weber Grills and unfortunately, due to the lack of customer service when a warranty file is claimed I will be purchasing a different brand from here on out and I will make sure everyone knows how I was treated by the customer service warranty department.
Results.Title: Terrible customer service.

Results.ReviewText:
I love it. I bought a Copper Kettle. Fantastic. 
I had to retire my old Weber. It was 30+ years old and the leg mounts rusted off. I gave it a proper burial.
Results.Title: Bye to an old friend

Results.ReviewText: Enjoy my recent purchase of the 22” new Weber charcoal kettle ( Green).  The total ease of operation is amazing; not only the grilling part, but the cleaning of the kettle afterwards… I found with a little time spent with clean up it seems that the new grill will remain just as new when I bought it… it cleans up great.
Results.Title: New to keep New

Results.ReviewText: I'm very satisfied with this grill. It heats up quickly and evenly, and the temperature control is excellent. The ash management system is also a great feature, making cleanup easy.
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22

Results.ReviewText: Good grill, well designed.  The assembly is difficult putting the legs on, both the clarity of which leg goes where and the force necessary to put them into the hole.  The ash collector takes a lot of grip force to remove and put on.
Results.Title: Well designed grill, not perfect

Results.ReviewText: Finally upgraded to a full sized grill after using my Smokey Joe since 1986!!  Now that I'm getting older it's nice to have something standing height.  I assume this will last just as long as the Smokey Joe (which is still our go to when camping) and if so, it's the last grill we'll ever have to buy.  We prefer charcoal over gas any day and just love the copper color of our new Weber.
Results.Title: Finally upgraded from the 1986 Smokey Joe!

Results.ReviewText:
This is the first Weber Kettle I have owned and I have to say, wow!  I love cooking on this grill and everything I’ve made so far has turned out great. I have been grilling and smoking for almost 20 years on a variety of grills. Offsets, barrels, uprights using gas, wood, charcoal and pellets. I am one that believes that each had a place depending on what your cooking and the time you have to commit to doing the work. 

So far on this Weber kettle I’ve cooked ribs, chicken, sausage, steak, veggies, and just did a 13 hour smoke on a 7lb Boston butt that made some of the best pulled pork I have tasted.  If you’re on the fence on buying one of these amazing grills, get down and buy it already!  You won’t regret it and with the sales at Home Depot, I got mine at a nice discount.
Results.Title: Awesome Multipurpose Grill

Results.ReviewText: Good qualtity item.  Nice grilling space.  Good sturdy handles
Results.Title: Good grilling surface area

Results.ReviewText: Great product, great value, and great food. Definitely one of the best charcoal grills you can buy.
Results.Title: 22' Weber Classic

Results.ReviewText: Love our new 22" kettle, my Fathers day/Birtyday gift! Replaces our Weber thats 30 years old!
Results.Title: Our new kettle

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, sturdy and not bad looking either!
Results.Title: Great purchase

Results.ReviewText: Fit of controls allows for good temperature control and even cooking and smoking of meats. This also allows for a quick shutdown of fire and allows for multiple uses of charcoal and wood.
Results.Title: My third kettle in 30 years

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Weber Kettle and I have to say every one has been a great grill. With all the accessories you can get for these now make them a go to in any situation. Low and slow or Blazing hot you can do it all.
Results.Title: Always Great Always Performs

Results.ReviewText: Unfortunately, the quality has gone down from my previous 22" Original Premium Grill. My old one had TWO handles, this new one only has one. The ash catcher sticks a lot when trying to turn it and it seems like the metal is a lesser grade.
Results.Title: Quality Slipping

Results.ReviewText: I’ve owned several WKs through the years.  Best charcoal grill I’ve every owned.  You can really do anything with it.  Watch videos & keep practicing.  You’ll become a pro!
Results.Title: The best!

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I ever bought very light and convenient
Results.Title: Goon with the spoon

Results.ReviewText: Grill was easy to assemble with few small parts. Ash catcher is bigger than I expected and can easily hold ash for 4 or 5 cooks. One item I would wish for is a knockout panel to install a 3rd party temp driven fan. This would help with long cooks and smokes.
Results.Title: Excellent as expected

Results.ReviewText: There are a few misses with this grill.  First, the charcoal grate is too low and makes it hard to get hot enough, even with lump charcoal.  The grate is also wide, so charcoal falls through.  I'll need to get a charcoal box.  Next, the wheels are too far under the grill.  It makes it easy to tip, which can be a fire hazard if you need to move the grill with hot coals.  Finally, the hook for the lid is hard to catch and the lid handle should be turned 90 degrees so you have torque to hold the lid while finding the lid hanging hook.  The current direction of the handle requires you to grip the handle very tightly because it wants to rotate flat while holding it with the hook at 12 o'clock.  On the plus side, the ash bucket is nice and secure.
Results.Title: A few misses.

Results.ReviewText: Tried and True Classic Been using ever Since I was taught how to BBQ
Results.Title: The Best is the Best

Results.ReviewText:
It’s a Weber, it’s got the Weber quality that You have grown to love. Best kettle made. My only complaint with it Is too short. If it were about 6 inches taller it would be perfect and I’m not a tall guy.
So far, I’ve only used it once, but it will last years.
Results.Title: It’s a Weber what else can be said?

Results.ReviewText: I have emailed customer service over a week ago of the app. Still no response.
Results.Title: Melted handle

Results.ReviewText: The reason for the missing star is that my grill came missing the screw to hold the handle together on the body of the grill.  When I went online, I found multiple complaints about the missing screw.
Results.Title: Good grill, when they pack all of the parts.

Results.ReviewText: Had the gas grill for several years and when that finally wore out, I decided to go back to the basic of BBQing.  More work involved but more satisfying as I found it to be in BBQing.  Taste makes one wonder why I ever stayed with a gas grill for so long!  Weber quality is still there and going strong.
Results.Title: Back to real BBQing

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill. I did notice the grill sits lower than the previous weber kettle grill I owned and the cooking grate seems lighter.
Results.Title: Still a Good Grill But...

Results.ReviewText: Solid grill all around. Weber there’s no substitute.
Results.Title: On Wisconsin

Results.ReviewText: I received this new grill as a replacement to the nearly identical model that I purchased 54 years ago. The old grill performed faithfully for all those years despite getting dented, losing its wheels and suffering a little rust. It cooked a large turkey for every Thanksgiving, and for many years travelled with me by car when we visited family for Thanksgiving. My family gave me the new one this year for my 85th birthday, because they felt my old one looked too beat up.
Results.Title: Replacement for my 54-year-old Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: As a gift, I received the original premium 22’ charcoal grill. Putting it together was difficult. Specifically the legs.  They will not completely insert into the base holes. They will not go in far enough to allow the button to pop out to hold the leg securely in place. Too, I find the Ash Catcher of poor quality. I had to bend it to fit.
Results.Title: Assembly Difficult and Frustrating

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
